instruction: Start the VLC player and load the music video file from my desktop that shows Never Gonna Give You Up by Rick Astley.

files.path: /home/user/Desktop/Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

rules.file_name: Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

metadata.explanation: Paraphrased variation emphasizing the video content (Never Gonna Give You Up by Rick Astley). Uses the same evaluator to verify VLC is playing the correct file by checking the filename in the status XML.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies VLC is playing the specified file
Complete coverage: checks both VLC state (playing) and file name match
Robust filename matching logic with multiple fallback methods (basename, endswith, path-aware)
Getter correctly extracts VLC status via HTTP interface and saves to XML file
Metric correctly parses XML and validates against expected file name
Expected value matches the actual downloaded file name from config
No parameter handling issues - metric uses 'rule' parameter correctly
